assumptions.statement: Official SITE_BOUNDARY and three KEY_AREA polygons are unavailable; central provisional geometry is used at low confidence.
assumptions.impact: All spatial quantities and positions are conceptual and require full-package recalculation.

assumptions.statement: PROV-KEY-003 is not anchored to Dazhongsi Station or roads; the package does not move it independently.
assumptions.impact: Dazhongsi station-city relationships are programme checklists only, not positioned design conclusions.

assumptions.statement: Statutory FAR, height, density, setbacks, land-use controls and parcel boundaries are missing.
assumptions.impact: These metrics remain unknown; design geometry is not a statutory control plan.

assumptions.statement: Existing buildings, ownership, structure, fire and heritage value have not been surveyed.
assumptions.impact: Building polygons are conceptual renewal envelopes; retain-renovate-demolish decisions remain open.

assumptions.statement: Road redlines, station interfaces, demand, parking, logistics and fire access data are missing.
assumptions.impact: Mobility lines show desired connections only and are not road or construction alignments.

assumptions.statement: Power, compute, water, drainage, flood, heat rejection, communications and cybersecurity capacity are unknown.
assumptions.impact: No infrastructure deployment or capacity claim is made.

assumptions.statement: Operators, budgets, procurement owners and long-term maintenance responsibilities are not confirmed.
assumptions.impact: Annual programmes and governance remain recommendations rather than commitments.

assumptions.statement: Public AI trials require opt-in, minimised data, a human alternative, appeal, expiry and an accountable professional.
assumptions.impact: Any scenario lacking these conditions remains below G2.

assumptions.statement: International cases are context-specific and drawn from official public pages.
assumptions.impact: Only mechanisms are transferred; no spatial form, branding or performance value is copied.
